typography.installation: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&display=swap');

usage_rules: Use Marigold (#FF9933) for primary CTAs (Book Now, Search).
Use Royal Teal (#008080) for trust elements (Maps, Info Cards).
Use Rani Pink (#FF007F) sparingly for 'Love' icons, 'Hot' deals, or active states.
Backgrounds should be Warm Sand (#FAF9F6) to evoke paper/parchment, not sterile white.

textures.grain: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay on the main background to reduce digital flatness.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-[#FF9933] text-white font-bold tracking-wide hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 border-2 border-[#008080] text-[#008080] font-medium hover:bg-[#008080] hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.destination: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl aspect-[3/4] cursor-pointer
cards.hotel: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-stone-100 hover:border-[#FF9933]/30 transition-colors p-4
cards.feature: bg-stone-50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-stone-100 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-md transition-all

inputs.search: h-14 pl-12 pr-4 rounded-full bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-stone-200 focus:border-[#FF9933] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF9933]/20 shadow-lg text-lg placeholder:text-stone-400

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 auto-rows-[200px]

modes.marketing: Use 'Tetris' grid: Mix hero spans (col-span-2 row-span-2) with standard tiles.
modes.dashboard: Use 'High Density' grid: Tight gap-4, uniform heights.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on colored backgrounds meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Use dark text on Marigold backgrounds if needed.

images.style: High saturation, warm tones, cinematic composition. Avoid staged stock photos.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, rounded caps. Color: #4A4A4A or Brand Colors.

hero.alt: Taj Mahal at Golden Hour through Archway

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Marigold', 'Royal Teal', and 'Rani Pink' colors.
3. BUILD THE HERO: Create a 'HeroSection' component that uses the Taj Mahal image with a glassmorphism search bar overlay.
4. USE SHADCN SMARTLY: Use Shadcn for complex interactions (DatePickers, Dialogs) but style them with the 'visual_enhancers' rules (rounded-xl, warm borders).
5. MAP INTEGRATION: Use 'react-leaflet' for the map. Style the map container with a thick white border and shadow-lg to make it look like a physical map.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button and input has a data-testid attribute (e.g., 'search-button', 'destination-card-kerala').
7. NO GENERIC GRIDS: When displaying destinations, use the 'Bento Grid' layout defined in 'grids_and_layouts'.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered text everywhere.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
